section_H8_backup_automation.subsystem: RunDailyBackup command + retention + restore drill + NF525 6y

1_technical_inventory.owner_decision_Q14_2026_05_21: Laravel-scheduler driven (not /etc/cron.d) — single source of truth in Kernel.php

retention_tiers_IN_CODE.quarterly: storage/backups/db-quarterly/quarterly-YYYY-QN.sql.gz, 24q retention, triggered on day-1 of Jan/Apr/Jul/Oct only

1_technical_inventory.spatie_laravel_backup_NOT_used: No vendor/spatie/laravel-backup integration — custom mysqldump pipeline + gzip + filesystem rotation. Simpler footprint, no Flysystem cloud adapter needed for V1 LOCAL.

2_NF525_retention_alignment.satisfies_NF525: CLAUDE.md §8: audit_logs + z_reports 6y retention at DB-dump level. fiscal:archive (Kernel.php #16) is the per-day signed ZIP+JSON archive; this lane is the full-DB safety net.
2_NF525_retention_alignment.row_level_NEVER_deleted: audit_logs + z_reports have BEFORE DELETE triggers SIGNAL SQLSTATE '45000'. Even if a SQL dump is pruned past 6 years, the table itself keeps every row forever (per CLAUDE.md §8).

3_durability_safeguards.atomicity: mysqldump writes to <final>.partial; on success rename() to <final>. Crash mid-dump leaves only .partial (cleaned up on next run via prepareDailyTarget). No corrupted valid-named file possible.
3_durability_safeguards.sanity_floor: Hard fail if final gzip < 1KB (clear truncation). Soft warn if < 1MB (suspicious but plausible on fresh dev DB).
3_durability_safeguards.failure_marker: storage/backups/.last-failure JSON written on any failure path with timestamp + reason + exit_code. Monitoring tails this file. Also Log::channel('observability').
3_durability_safeguards.mysqldump_flags: --single-transaction --routines --triggers --events --set-gtid-purged=OFF — snapshot-consistent on InnoDB without locking writers; --set-gtid-purged=OFF added after 2026-05-21 restore drill caught ER_GTID_PURGED_CONTAINS_EXEC failure on restore target
3_durability_safeguards.credentials_safe: MYSQL_PWD env var (never argv) — matches scripts/db/backup.sh:169 pattern
3_durability_safeguards.idempotent_today: If daily-YYYY-MM-DD.sql.gz already exists today, log 'skip_existing' + continue to rotation (which is also idempotent — copy is no-op if monthly/quarterly already exists)
3_durability_safeguards.sqlite_fallback: If config('database.default')==='sqlite', cp+gzip the .sqlite file (CI / dev) — same rotation logic

adversarial_top_3.scenario: AppServiceProvider boot guard line 295 forbids CACHE_DRIVER='array'|'null' but allows 'file' + 'database'. Block comment (lines 286-293) states intent is 'redis or memcached for cross-worker locks' but implementation is narrower. V1 LOCAL Le Cayenne single-box: file driver is SAFE (flock serializes across PHP-FPM workers on same box). V2 SaaS ALB multi-instance: file driver becomes per-host = NF525 audit_chain Cache::lock no longer cross-worker = potential chain integrity hazard.
adversarial_top_3.evidence: app/Providers/AppServiceProvider.php:286-302 + CLAUDE.md §8 NF525 Production boot guards + reports/audit-verify-other-session-2026-05-21.md Claim 1
adversarial_top_3.exploitation_difficulty: Zero in V1 (single-box). Becomes real in V2 cloud deployment.
adversarial_top_3.blast_radius: V1: none. V2: theoretical chain HMAC collision under concurrent multi-host write. Even then, DB UNIQUE(branch_id, prev_hash) catches the worst case.
adversarial_top_3.owner_action: V1.0.X cloud-prep backlog UNI-03. Widen forbidden list to ['array','null','file','database','apc','octane'] before V2 ALB cutover.
adversarial_top_3.verdict: V1.0.X CLOUD-PREP BACKLOG, NOT V1 SHIP BLOCKER — single-box scope makes file driver acceptable today

H6_cache.if_invalidation_chain_breaks: Kiosk shows stale menu for up to 60s (TTL fallback). Customer adds out-of-stock item to cart → submit-time revalidation (OrderService::storeOrder + assertItemsOrderableForBranch) catches the mismatch → 422 rejection with French error message. NO order created with stale-cached item. Bad UX, no fiscal/security/data impact.
H6_cache.if_UNI_03_cloud_cutover_with_file_driver: NF525 audit_chain Cache::lock becomes per-host → concurrent admin writes from different hosts could race on prev_hash. DB UNIQUE(branch_id, prev_hash) catches the collision (INSERT fails) but the user sees a 500. Recovery: widen forbidden list before cutover. V1 LOCAL: no impact.

H7_cron.if_NF525_quintet_lane_fails: Lane #15 (chain monitor) non-zero exit pages on-call → manual intervention. Lane #16 (archive) partial failure logs per-branch with continue-on-error — single branch crash doesn't halt others. Lanes #17/#20 (Z-close/Z-open) idempotent: double-close-safe + already-open-safe via STATUS_OPEN pre-check.
H7_cron.if_scheduler_itself_misses_a_minute: * * * * * schedule:run drives all lanes. If schedule:run misses a tick, withoutOverlapping ensures no double-fire on recovery; per-lane info-log on no-op when state already satisfied (Z-close skips if no open Z, etc.). NF525 archive could miss a day → fiscal:archive-daily takes --from/--to args and could be re-run manually.
H7_cron.owner_visible_latencies: Stripe stranded CPN ~10min p99, fiscal sequence orphan via Z-loop ~2min, both bounded with retry paths.

H8_backup.if_backup_fails: storage/backups/.last-failure JSON written + Log::channel('observability')->error fires. Daily verification probe (CRONTAB_PROD.md §2.2) tails backup.log every 04:30 and pages if 'OK' missing. Owner notified within 1.5h of failure.
H8_backup.if_restore_needed: Daily-tier restore drill PASS 2026-05-21 — proven restorable. Quarterly-tier first artifact 2026-07-01, drill schedule fires 2026-07-05. Until then quarterly restore is unproven (but daily tier covers operational recovery; quarterly is for NF525 long-tail).
H8_backup.NF525_at_row_level: Even if every backup file is destroyed, audit_logs + z_reports DB rows are protected by BEFORE DELETE triggers — append-only forever. Backups are the SECOND defense layer, not the only one.

consolidated_verdict.narrative: All 3 hidden ops systems production-grade for V1 LOCAL Le Cayenne. Cache discipline mature (5/5 I.3 chain verified, explicit forget on every catalog mutation, fallback TTL only as safety net). Cron scheduler comprehensive (20 lanes, NF525 quintet + Z-loop pair, K2-HEAL-05 + I2-HEAL-04 close historic holes, all concurrency primitives in place). Backup automation robust (atomic .partial→final, sanity thresholds, multi-tier rotation, failure marker, daily-tier restore drill PASS 2026-05-21). 3 adversarial scenarios all bounded — none are V1 ship blockers; #1 is owner-acknowledged Path A compromise, #2 is design tradeoff, #3 is V1.0.X cloud-prep backlog. 2 P3 documentation-drift findings on CRONTAB_PROD.md (claims weekly tier not in code, line numbers stale post GAP-HUNT 2026-05-25). Zero frozen-zone touch this session.
